findings.summary: The measured series is given label="band residual" but the script never renders a legend and never directly labels the blue trace, so the rendered PNG carries two annotated reference lines (the dashed fit, 'fitted order 1.96', and the dotted threshold, 'threshold 1.0e-03') and one unlabelled coloured measurement series. A reader resolves the blue trace only by elimination against the y-axis label and the caption, rather than by an identification carried in the figure. This does not stop anyone reading the figure - there is exactly one data series and the axis label names the plotted ratio - so it is recorded as non-blocking rather than holding the node.

item_verdicts.contrast: passes - the axis, tick and annotation text is near-black on white, and the grey 'threshold 1.0e-03' annotation plus the grey dotted threshold line read clearly against the white field at the repository's declared #929292 reference grey; nothing is lost against the background.
item_verdicts.data_ink: passes - four markers, their connecting line, the dashed fit and the dotted threshold are the only marks on a plain white field, and they carry the visual weight; the four markers sit at evenly spaced log-x positions matching the four grid resolutions the caption names, so the series reads as the convergence measurement itself.
item_verdicts.decoration: passes - no gradient, no background fill, no shading, no gridline and no frame appears anywhere in the rendered PNG; the top and right spines are absent, leaving only the two scaled axes, and the only non-data ink is the grey dotted threshold reference, which the caption names as EDGE_BAND_RELATIVE_THRESHOLD.
item_verdicts.label_collision: passes - in the rendered PNG the 'threshold 1.0e-03' annotation sits above the dotted line in clear space, the 'fitted order 1.96' annotation sits below-left of the dashed fit line in empty space, neither annotation touches the data line, the dashed fit line or each other, and no text artist is clipped: the y-axis label, both annotation strings, every tick label and the x-axis label sit wholly inside the canvas.
item_verdicts.legibility: passes - the rendered PNG is a single log-log panel with one blue measurement series of four round markers joined by a 3 pt line, a black dashed power-law fit drawn just beneath it, and a grey dotted threshold line; the axis labels 'radial grid spacing [m]' and 'band residual / profile current', the decade tick labels (6x10^-3, 10^-2, 2x10^-2, 3x10^-2, 4x10^-2 on x; 10^-3 and 10^-4 on y), and both annotations ('fitted order 1.96', 'threshold 1.0e-03') are all readable at a glance without zooming.
item_verdicts.table_form: passes - the image plots the band residual against radial grid spacing on log-log axes; the quantity the figure exists to show is the slope of the four-point sequence, which is a plotted relationship rather than a table lookup, so nothing it depicts is naturally a table.
